founding_year.basis: 'An $8.3 million "micro" seed fund that Stebbings began managing under the 20VC name in April 2020' (Fortune, 2021-06-16); the adviser, Twenty VC LLP, was incorporated on 2021-03-02 (Companies House OC435791); the podcast itself dates from 2015 and is the media business, not the firm.

history.value: 20VC was founded in London in 2020 by Harry Stebbings, host of The Twenty Minute VC podcast, with an $8.3 million first fund. It became known for early bets on Clubhouse, Hopin and Lovable, and for leading Tripledot's $116 million Series B. In 2024 it raised $400 million across its third seed fund and a Series A fund.
history.basis: founding, city, founder and first fund: Fortune 2021-06-16 ('The London-based 24-year-old'; the $8.3M micro seed fund from April 2020 'has made investments in ... Hopin and social media app Clubhouse, as well as RevenueCat'); Lovable: 'existing investors, which include 20VC' at the July 2025 Series A (TechCrunch, 2025-07-17); Tripledot: 'The round is being led by 20VC', $116M Series B (TechCrunch, 2022-02-14); 2024: 'About $125 million of the fund will be dedicated to seed investments, and $275 million will go to Series A rounds' (TechCrunch, 2024-10-15). Moved to the basis: the second fund pair of 2021 ($33M seed, $107M growth, 'which raised $140 million in 2021'), the SPVs S-1 to S-5, D-1, SPV1 and SPV2, the operator funds 20Growth, 20Product and 20Sales (separate vehicles run by their operator partners, outside the portfolio on this page) and Project Europe (a separate fund).

investment_concept.value: “20VC operates at the intersection of venture capital and media.”
investment_concept.basis: The firm's own statement, verbatim from the homepage headline (set in capitals by the site's CSS; the markup is client-rendered, so it was read in a rendered browser on 2026-09-28). Sentence case, straight text and a closing period are the only edits. Competing lines on the page: the title tag '20VC Fund | The Intersection of Venture Capital and Media' and the meta description '20VC operates at the intersection of venture and media. 20VC invests in early-stage startups targeting large markets with low competition.' Published inside quotation marks, as the firm's own words (Erik, 2026-09-26).

investment_stage.basis: the firm's own words: 'a $33 million fund will be dedicated to pre-seed and seed investments ... a larger, $107 million fund will target "growth stage" startups' (Fortune, 2021-06-16); 'About $125 million of the fund will be dedicated to seed investments, and $275 million will go to Series A rounds' (TechCrunch, 2024-10-15); the team's titles read 'General Partner - Pre-Seed & Seed' and 'Partner - Series A & Growth' (20vc.fund/team). The landed entry distribution is restated in report.md.

investment_geo.basis: the 2024 funds' stated focus on European startups (TechCrunch, 2024-10-15: 'will focus on backing startups in the region') and the portfolio on this page by country: Europe 67 (UK 26, France 18, Germany 9 and ten more), US 43 (Fund I of 2020 was US-leaning), Australia 5, Pakistan 2, and four more single companies. Core Europe, other US and Australia.

investment_scope.basis: focus from the firm's own site sector tags on 84 base rows, crosswalked to data/taxonomy/focus.json (crosswalk in config.json), published above 6 companies. Scope type is the curated judgement carried in investor.json.

investment_range.basis: median: $9.0M, the median entry round over the 68 companies whose entry round is cited with a USD size (by stage: Pre-Seed $5.5M over 6, Seed $5.5M over 37, Series A $15.0M over 17, Growth $48.9M over 8). It is a round size, not a cheque size. lower: the firm's own stated minimum cheque, 'pre-seed and seed investments, each totaling between $250,000 to $500,000' (Fortune, 2021-06-16; Fund I wrote $100,000 to $300,000 in 2020, TechCrunch 2020-07-17). upper: the largest round the firm led, Tripledot's $116M Series B (TechCrunch, 2022-02-14), a round size like the median; the Explorer growth cheques were stated at $3M to $5M (Fortune, 2021-06-16) and the largest single-company vehicle, 20VC Fund S-1, sold $55.7M (Form D, November 2021). Rejected: AMI Labs' $1.03B seed as a range end (a syndicated round, 20VC a minor participant).

notable_investments.basis: The five best known of the firm's own companies, most recognised first (PRO-152, Erik 2026-09-24): Perplexity and Lovable (named by the firm in its own releases), Clubhouse and Hopin (Fund I, Fortune 2021-06-16) and BeReal (the firm's own list of 2022-2023, and its press line 'portfolio includes companies like Hopin ... Sorare ... and BeReal'). Considered next: Linear, Mercor, Sorare, Poolside, Remote.

aum.basis: both ends: the sworn Form ADV Section 7.B(1) gross asset values of the firm's only adviser, Twenty VC LLP (CRD 316359, SEC 802-122639; London; exempt reporting adviser, FCA-registered), annual amendment of 2025-06-17: six private funds, $602,711,121 in all (Explorer Fund III $276,103,289; Fund III $125,501,224; Explorer Fund II $97,197,156; S-1 $63,971,663; Fund II $37,068,827; D-1 $2,868,962; the six sum to the roster total to the dollar). An exempt reporting adviser files no Item 5.F, so the 7.B composite is both ends. Not in it: Fund I, a series of 20Growth/20Product/20Sales, LP (reported under Section 7.B(2) by AngelList Advisors), and the SPVs S-2 to S-5 formed after the amendment (Form D sales $12.2M, $10.06M, $6.49M and $10.05M, 2025-07 to 2026-06). Press 'about $650 million' figures sit above the sworn number and are not used.

funds.basis: sizes as the firm announced them: Fund III $125M (seed) and Explorer Fund III $275M (Series A), one $400M close in 2024 (TechCrunch, 2024-10-15; one co-issued Form D of $400M, first sale 2024-04-18, CIKs 1921168 and 1921021); Fund II $33M (pre-seed and seed) and Explorer Fund II $107M (growth), 2021 (Fortune, 2021-06-16; Form Ds, first sale 2021-06-14, CIKs 1852410 and 1852406); Fund I $8.3M, 2020 (Fortune; it filed as 'Fund I, a series of 20VC, LP', CIK 1808687, $2.08M sold to 28 investors on its first Form D). Counted, not listed: the single-deal and co-investment vehicles 20VC Fund S-1 to S-5, D-1, SPV1 and SPV2 (Form D, 2021-2026). No accession is asserted: the fund Form Ds report offering-level sales that do not map one to one to these sizes.

hq_location.basis: Principal office on the newest Form ADV: 16 Berkeley Mews, London, United Kingdom (TWENTY VC LLP, CRD 316359, Annual Amendment filed 2025-06-17). The firm's site names no office in its served pages (2 checked), so the Form ADV stands. Rule (Erik 2026-09-24): the newest Form ADV principal office, unless the firm's own site disagrees, and then the site wins.
